G7 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
The chain is fitted on LEVELS discretised into quantile states, which throws away
magnitude within a state. That is the price of the discreteness that bounds it, and
it means a chain cannot express a large move even when a large move is correct.
The persisted artefact is the three-block set point, not loop 213's ten-block
0.5474, so G3 and G6 condition on the weaker one. If conditioning fails here it
could still succeed on the better set point, and that is not tested.
A time-homogeneous chain assumes the transition matrix does not change with time
since the drug. The A549 grid spans 30 to 720 minutes and the biology plainly does
change over it; loop 191c already found a batch discontinuity at 25-30 minutes.
Still one cell line, one perturbation, one channel, 600 genes.
